integrity: The graph, full finite group and two independent character calculations are reconstructed by executable exact standard-library Python; a primitive integral invariant is checked. Independent mathematical audit and external certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the Pappus incidence graph at inclusive graph-distance threshold three. No integral quotient torsion, equivariant homotopy type, or homology actions at other thresholds are determined. The nonequivariant wedge count was already established. Priority requires independent literature review.
title: A primitive invariant in the Pappus graph's degree-five Rips homology
